nodes.label: Input: nums; compute popcounts a[]
nodes.action:
ctx['nums'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['n'] = len(ctx['nums']); ctx['a'] = []
for v in ctx['nums']:
    c = 0
    w = v
    while w:
        c += w & 1
        w >>= 1
    ctx['a'].append(c)
ctx['i'] = 0; ctx['prev_max'] = -1; ctx['ok'] = True

nodes.label: Start group: cnt = a[i], j = i
Close group: check prev_max <= gmin; prev_max = gmax; i = j
nodes.action: ctx['gmin'] = min(ctx['nums'][ctx['i']:ctx['j']]); ctx['gmax'] = max(ctx['nums'][ctx['i']:ctx['j']]); ctx['ok'] = ctx['ok'] and ctx['prev_max'] <= ctx['gmin']; ctx['prev_max'] = ctx['gmax']; ctx['i'] = ctx['j']
